description: TSMC Process GAT MAML architecture sweep (11D node features: 7 base + 4 process params)

_comments.model_type: GAT (Graph Attention Network) with multi-head attention
_comments.heads_note: Number of attention heads. conv_hidden_dim should be divisible by heads for efficient computation
_comments.num_fc_layers_note: GAT supports only 2 or 3 FC layers
_comments.voltage_mode_options: all_nodes (voltage to all nodes) or vdd_only (voltage only on VDD node)
_comments.cache_path_note: Override topology cache path. Use gatectrl cache for gate control edges
_comments.output_node_idx_note: output_node_idx is now dynamically determined from topology cache (fallback default: 2)
_comments.related_pin_only_note: Set true to use related_pin_only dataset. Input slew assigned only to triggering input port. Adds _relpin suffix to paths.
_comments.resume_note: Set auto_resume=true to automatically find and continue from latest checkpoint. Set resume to a specific .pth file path. additional_iterations overrides total_iterations when resuming.
